Remark
[standard tangential Jacobi fields]

↗ def:dc-ch5-2-1

1. ch5:2.2Both $\gamma '$ and $t\gamma '$ are Jacobi fields along $\gamma $. The former is parallel and nowhere zero for a nonconstant geodesic, while the latter vanishes exactly at $t=0$. Jacobi fields orthogonal to $\gamma '$ will be called normal Jacobi fields.
Proof

\sketch The assertions follow from $\nabla _{\gamma '}\gamma '=0$ and $R(\gamma ',\gamma ')\gamma '=0$.

□
